heading: 17. Real-time / embedded / determinism
text:
## 17. Real-time / embedded / determinism [LUNI.17]

The compile-time core is sound. The one open exposure is `float64`-only
storage on no-FPU targets ([LUNI.17.3]). A tier-2 conversion or a
`unit formula` that uses a transcendental function is bit-identical on every
engine, because each function is correctly rounded and the expression is
evaluated as written ([LDET.3.4.4]).
